nom: belif Dew Guard Daily Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the sunscreen as hydrating and dewy, saying it doesn't feel dry or chalky even on dry-prone skin (32, 36).
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report the formula as calming, non-stinging, and non-irritating even around the eyes, with some noting a helpful reduction in sun-triggered redness, though one sensitive reviewer's eyes get irritated if product gets in them (22, 45, 29, 34).
segments.mature: One 49-year-old reviewer with fair, redness-prone mature skin reports no white cast, a dewy finish, and no pilling under makeup or primer (25); another describes it generally suited to dry, mature skin (8).
segments.oily: One reviewer notes uncertainty about performance on oily skin, and several others across skin types describe the finish as non-greasy despite mineral formulation, though a few dissent and call it greasy or heavy (8, 10, 11).

concerns.aging: One reviewer highlights the product as well-suited to mature skin in dry, winter conditions, though this is a single, brief mention (8).
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report the sunscreen feels moisturizing and dewy, sometimes replacing a moisturizer, including one reviewer with dry skin who found it did not feel drying (32, 36, 12, 50).
concerns.redness: Many reviewers report visibly reduced redness or a calming effect on flushed skin, including sensitive and mature reviewers; one reviewer disliked the slight tint some perceive as reducing redness, finding it unwanted on her skin (23, 25, 30, 40, 46, 52, 14).
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers mention no stinging, no irritation, and gentle wear even under makeup, suggesting good tolerance, though one reviewer developed sensitivity to the niacinamide in the formula (9, 15, 16).
concerns.spots: No reviewers specifically discuss dark spots or hyperpigmentation; only general skin-tone evening is mentioned by a few (24, 34).
concerns.blemishes: Acne-prone and breakout-concerned reviewers mostly report no new breakouts or clogged pores even with reapplication, but one reviewer with acne-prone skin decided to limit use to body only, fearing it could clog facial pores (39, 31, 7, 0).
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers generally describe the finish as non-greasy and non-oily despite the mineral formula, but a notable minority call it greasy, tacky, or heavy, especially with reapplication (13, 48, 41, 11, 0, 10).

aspects.libelle: Wears well under makeup without pilling

extraits.texte: I'm not a fan of this sunscreen. I tried it on my face but now I regret it--it left a pronounced white cast and it feels greasy and tacky to the touch, even 10 minutes after applying it. I'm going to strictly use it on my neck and body from now on because I feel like it could clog pores and cause breakouts on my face. The packaging says that it "visibly brightens dull skin tone" but I don't see any of that happening, unless by "brighten," they mean lighten. My face is definitely several shades lighter than my body, which is not the look I'm going for.

belif is a popular Korean brand and I've enjoyed few of their skincare products. This new mineral sunscreen is overall fantastic. Love that it has high spf 50 without the horrible white or gray cast. It does have minimal whitening initially but not perceptible after dry down. It has a light lemony scent, no typical sunblock smell. The consistency is not as lightweight or slippery, more like a creamy lotion. It applies evenly but feels a bit thick on skin although it's not greasy or sticky. It has various silicones in the ingredients so it does help to prime skin for makeup. Not overly mattifying but no shine throughout wear. Not drying. No irritations. It's great for dry, mature skins and in winters. Not sure how this fares for oily skins or in summers. A respectable mineral sunscreen.

extraits.titre: I'm Very Picky About Sunscreen, and I'm So Glad I Tried This
extraits.texte: I've gone through so many sunscreens trying to find the right one for my sensitive skin, and this one from belif really impressed me. It's a mineral sunscreen with SPF 50, which is already a win for me, but what makes it special is how light and comfortable it feels on the skin. It doesn't leave a white cast, which is something I've struggled with in the past, especially with mineral formulas. What I also love is that it sits really well under makeup. No pilling, no greasy finish, just a smooth base. I have sensitive skin that tends to get red when I'm out in the sun too long, and this sunscreen actually helps calm that down. After a few days of using it, I noticed my skin looked more even and less irritated. If you're someone who's sensitive, easily irritated, or just super selective with sunscreen like me—this one is absolutely worth a try.

extraits.titre: Subtle scent, no white cast or pilling when layering
extraits.texte: My initial thought is that the 50mL (1.69 oz) packaging size is great for travel. The applicator works well and there is no mess. The product scent is very subtle. The consistency of the product is like a lotion. Although the product color is white, it blended easily and did not leave a white cast on my 49-year old, fair, redness-prone skin. Within 5 minutes, it had absorbed to a dewy finish and I was able to layer primer and foundation without any pilling. I live in the Southwest desert where the sun is strong and this product was effective at preventing sunburn.

extraits.titre: Loved the Sun Coverage from this!
extraits.texte: Belif kindly sent me the Dew Guard - mineral sunscreen SPF 50 for free to review. I loved this sunscreen, it gave great sun coverage and was a wonderful base under some light makeup. It went on smooth and I felt that it went on very evenly. The only slight downside was a minimal white cast and some fragrance. I have sensitive skin and the fragrance didn't bother me and seemed to disappear quickly. I loved that this also helped with redness on my cheeks!

I received this product in exchange for a review and I was so excited because I use a ton of sunscreen! I really loved this product because it was really lightweight on my skin and didn't feel sticky or heavy. Sometimes with other brands, I get a lot of clogged pores, but this one was perfect! I reapplied every 90 minutes and didn't get any breakouts! I will continue to use Dew Guard sunscreen because I loved this one so much!

extraits.titre: Perfect facial to wear every day in the summer!
extraits.texte: I love the light fresh scent of this sunscreen. It isn't the typical sunscreen scent found with most sun-protecting products. It feels lightweight and is not greasy. It is perfect to wear under makeup and the moisturizing effect is great for my dry skin. So far it seems to have reduced redness, but the full effect will be seen after long term use.
